About.title: About FAOS - Our Heritage of Purity
About.description: FAOS is a premier purveyor of organic olive oil and honey, meticulously crafted from 100% natural ingredients. Our digital brochure provides an in-depth look at our curated product range and our unwavering commitment to quality.
About.philosophy: Our philosophy is rooted in the harmony between nature and health, ensuring every drop is as pure as nature intended.

HowToShop.title: How to Place an Order
HowToShop.ariaLabel: Step-by-step guide on how to purchase products
HowToShop.step1: 1. Browse our curated collection, select your preferred items, and click <important>“Add to Cart”</important> to save them to your shopping bag.
HowToShop.step2: 2. Access your cart via the icon at the top right to review your items. You may adjust quantities or remove items before proceeding.
HowToShop.step3: 3. Once you have confirmed your selection, click <important>“Place Order”</important> to enter our secure checkout environment.
HowToShop.step4: 4. You will be redirected to Stripe, our secure payment gateway, to enter your details and complete your transaction safely.

CardPayment.title: Debit / Credit Card Payment
CardPayment.ariaLabel: Instructions for payment via debit or credit card
CardPayment.description: We support all major global payment networks. Secure payments can be made using debit or credit cards from any established bank worldwide.
CardPayment.acceptedCards: We accept cards with the <important>Visa, Mastercard, or JCB</important> logo, including virtual cards and international credit cards for your convenience.
CardPayment.securityNote: Your transaction is fully encrypted and protected by Stripe’s world-class security infrastructure.

QRCodePayment.title: QR Code Payment (Mobile Banking)
QRCodePayment.ariaLabel: Instructions for payment via QR Code
QRCodePayment.description: For a more efficient checkout, you may pay instantly via QR Code. This method is highly recommended for regional convenience.
QRCodePayment.method: Simply scan the <important>PromptPay QR Code</important> using your mobile banking app. This service is compatible with major banks and incurs no additional transaction fees.
QRCodePayment.expiryNote: * Please ensure your payment is finalised within the time limit shown on the checkout page to avoid order cancellation.

advertise.title: Discover the world of Extra Virgin Olive Oil: Natural benefits and essential facts for your well-being
messages: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (EVOO) is the highest grade of oil, produced through a meticulous process that prioritizes quality over quantity.
Rich in polyphenols with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, protecting the oil from oxidation and preserving its flavour and nutritional value.
Contains Oleocanthal, which functions similarly to ibuprofen, helping to regulate cellular activity within inflamed cells and reduce swelling throughout the body.
Helps balance cholesterol and triglyceride levels while reducing LDL oxidation for better cardiovascular and heart health.
Polyphenolic compounds help improve mental health and prevent neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and dementia.
Enhances insulin efficiency in maintaining balanced blood sugar levels and plays a vital role in alleviating symptoms of Metabolic Syndrome (MS).
Contains 'Sitosterol' which helps regulate cholesterol absorption, strengthening the digestive system and providing reliable relief from constipation.
Produced from unique ancient olive varieties like Athenolia and Koroneiki, which contain exceptionally high levels of polyphenols and antioxidants.
Uses traditional cold-pressing techniques using only mechanical methods; unrefined, unbleached, and chemical-free to maintain maximum purity.
Polyphenols work by reducing free radical damage, strengthening the heart, and boosting energy levels, making it a perfect choice for naturally enhancing athletic performance.
